sections.title: How to Make AI Sound EXACTLY Like you

items.q: What should you remember about capture into one home before you ask the model to sound like you.?
items.a: **Capture into one home** before you ask the model to sound like you.

items.q: What should you remember about brain system (how you think) and voice style guide (how you write per medium) stay separate.?
items.a: **Brain system (how you think)** and voice style guide (how you write per medium) stay separate.

items.q: What should you remember about if a sample does not contain a pattern, the model should ask, not guess.?
items.a: **If a sample does** not contain a pattern, the model should ask, not guess.

items.q: What should you remember about review every draft. Faster drafts are the point. Unreviewed output is not.?
items.a: **Review every draft. Faster** drafts are the point. Unreviewed output is not.

items.q: What should you remember about pull from you not push. You pick the idea. The model does not tell you what to publish.?
items.a: **pull from you not push. You** pick the idea. The model does not tell you what to publish.
